items: Introduction

This Privacy Policy ( defined below ) sets out how CKPC Properties ( defined below ) processes your Personal Data ( defined below ) when you visit and navigate this Website ( defined below ). This includes information on how CKPC Properties collects, uses and discloses your Personal Data, the purposes for processing such Personal Data, and the reasonable security practices and procedures followed by CKPC Properties in respect of Personal Data. This Privacy Policy also explains the rights that Visitors ( defined below ) have regarding their Personal Data.
Some Important Terms: Below are some important terms and how we define them for the purposes of this Privacy Policy. Other terms may be defined in the body of the Privacy Policy below.
“ CKPC Properties ”, “ We ”, “ us ”, “ our ”, and linguistic variations of these refer to CKPC Properties Private Limited and its subsidiaries and affiliates.

“ Personal Data ” means data about an individual who is identifiable by or in relation to such data. Personal Data includes data such as the name, e-mail address, and mobile telephone number of a Visitor. It also includes data connected with access to and use of the Website, such as IP addresses.
“ Privacy Policy ” means this privacy policy, which governs CKPC Properties’ processing of your Personal Data, as updated from time to time.
“ Visitor ”, “ you ”, “ your ” and linguistic variations of these refer to any person who accesses, navigates and/or uses this Website for any purpose.
“ Website ” means this website with the domain https://www.ckpcproperties.com/ , including all publicly visible webpages at all sub-domains as well.
CKPC Properties respects the privacy of Visitors and is committed to protect their Personal Data in all respects.

Whether or not to provide Personal Data to CKPC Properties is at the choice of Visitors. By using or accessing the Website, Visitors agree to the terms and conditions of this Privacy Policy. Visitors also expressly consent to CKPC Properties’ processing of their Personal Data in any manner as described in this Privacy Policy.
In addition to this Privacy Policy, certain terms apply to the access and use of this Website, as set out in our Terms of Use .
Collection of Personal Data
CKPC Properties collects Personal Data from Visitors in the following cases:

Use of the Website : CKPC Properties may collect (or receive, from third party sources) details pertaining to Visitor visits to the Website (such as IP addresses of Visitors, pages visited/clicked upon, and time spent on each page). We may also implement cookies, beacons, pixels, tags or UTM parameters (collectively, “ Cookies ”) which allow us to track the performance of our sponsored campaigns, ads, organic and marketing campaigns on various social media.

Expression of Interest : When Visitors express their interest to know more about any residential or commercial properties being developed by CKPC Properties, they may be prompted to provide their names, email addresses and/or mobile phone numbers.

Email Interactions: Details of Visitor interactions with any e-mails that CKPC Properties sends to such Visitors (where they have chosen to provide their email addresses to us), by implementing Cookies in such communications, such as time of opening, number of times opened, and whether any links in such emails were clicked by a specific Visitor.
Purposes for Processing Personal Data
We collect and process Personal Data on our Website for the following purposes:

Analytics : CKPC Properties collects and uses Personal Data when you access the Website to help us learn more about Visitors’ preferences (to enable the personalisation of the Website or to prioritise certain kinds of content), to help address problems with and improve the Website, to analyse trends and statistics, and to present content with the most clarity and usability.

Advertising : CKPC Properties also receives information from, and presents information to, our online advertisers and brand holders, to better understand our audience and confirm the value of advertising on the Website. To this end, we may also analyse Website traffic and clickthroughs, including in aggregated form, to make strategic marketing decisions, and share insights or aggregated data with online advertising service providers.

Electronic Communications : CKPC Properties will only contact Visitors for direct marketing purposes via emails, text message or instant communication services when Visitors give CKPC Properties their communication details, consenting to such outreach. By voluntarily providing their contact details to CKPC Properties, Visitors expressly consent to receiving communications via call, SMS, email, WhatsApp or other communication channels regarding CKPC Properties’ projects, products, offers and services, even if their contact number is registered under Do Not Disturb (DND) or similar preference registries, subject to applicable laws. Visitors may opt-out from receiving further marketing messages at any time by sending an e-mail to info@ckpcproperties.com, tapping the ‘Unsubscribe’ link (if provided) or following instructions provided in any direct marketing communications sent to them.
Securing CKPC Properties assets : CKPC Properties may also process Visitor Personal Data to protect the security or integrity of the Website and CKPC Properties’ business.
Disclosure and Sharing of Information
CKPC Properties treats Personal Data as strictly confidential.

CKPC Properties may involve other companies in providing certain Website-related activities to Visitors, and with whom CKPC Properties may share Visitor Personal Data. This includes third party service providers for data analytics, payments, database hosting and data processing, customer outreach and other similar purposes. Where CKPC Properties engages such third party service providers that use Personal Data, CKPC Properties will ensure that such Personal Data is processed for the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, and according to the contractual terms entered into between CKPC Properties and such third party companies.

In the event CKPC Properties sells or transfers all or a portion of its business assets, consumer information may be one of the business assets that are shared, disclosed or transferred as part of the transaction. In such case, Visitor Personal Data may be transferred to such transferee.

CKPC Properties may also share Personal Data where necessary to comply with any legal obligation or direction from any governmental authorities, in the course of judicial or quasi-judicial proceedings or in order to enforce or apply the Terms of Use , or any other agreements.

CKPC Properties may also transfer or disclose Visitor Personal Data or other information for business purposes, including within our subsidiaries and affiliates, to the extent permitted by applicable laws.

Third Party Links The Website may also include links to third party websites. Such websites are governed by their respective privacy policies, which are beyond CKPC Properties’ control. Once the Visitor leaves the Website, provision of information by the Visitor is governed by the privacy policy of the operator of the website which the Visitor is visiting. Visitors are encouraged to carefully review any such privacy policies of third party websites. CKPC Properties expressly disclaims any responsibility for the privacy practices or the content of such third party websites.
Security Practices and Procedures
CKPC Properties strives to ensure the security, integrity and privacy of Visitors’ Personal Data and to protect Personal Data against unauthorised access, use, disclosure, alteration or destruction.

CKPC Properties implements, and requires third parties to implement, security safeguards that are commensurate to the nature of Personal Data and the associated security risks, in line with industry standards.

To the extent that no security system is impenetrable, CKPC Properties cannot guarantee the security of any Visitor Personal Data. CKPC Properties disclaims all responsibility for any breach of security or any action of any third parties that are receiving Visitor’s Personal Data.
Retention of Data

CKPC Properties retains and processes Personal Data for as long as necessary until: (i) the relevant purposes for the use of such Personal Data have been achieved; or (ii) until deletion of such Personal Data is requested by the individual to whom it relates (unless a separate basis or legal requirement exists for the retention of such Personal Data); or (iii) as mandated under any applicable laws, regulations, or by order of a judicial or quasi-judicial authority.

Processing of Financial Data CKPC Properties does not collect, process or disclose any financial data from Visitors on our Website. Should any Visitors express interest in knowing more about any of CKPC Properties’ projects, Visitors will be provided further information and documentation on such projects/properties, and if they so desire, will be able to make a booking and pay a booking amount towards this. Any information collected and processed for such payments will be governed by terms shared with such persons at the time of making such bookings.

Contact Us Any questions, clarifications, concerns or grievances with respect to this Privacy Policy or CKPC Properties’ practices concerning Personal Data, or requests for review or deletion of Personal Data, may be addressed to CKPC Properties’ representatives at: info@ckpcproperties.com

Changes to the Privacy Policy This Privacy Policy was posted on 03-06-2025. CKPC Properties reserves the right to periodically review or change the Privacy Policy to incorporate such future changes as may be considered appropriate. Any material changes to the Privacy Policy will be posted on this page and where appropriate, notified to Visitors by e-mail. Any Visitors’ continued usage of the Website after such changes constitutes their consent to such changes. Visitors are encouraged to check the Privacy Policy regularly so as to be aware of modifications, if any.
